user.description: Choose the name and setup type for your color temperature mixer

data_description.name: The name of the light
data_description.setup_type: Select 'Dual light' to use two separate light entities (warm and cold), or 'RGBW controller' to use a single RGBW controller (e.g. Shelly RGBW2) with configurable channel mapping

dual_light.description: Configure the two lights that represent the warm and cold light channels

data_description.warm_light_entity_id: Light acting as the warmer light source (yellow-ish color)
data_description.warm_light_color_temp_kelvin: Color temperature of the warm light source (in Kelvin)
data_description.cold_light_entity_id: Light acting as the colder light source (blue-ish color)
data_description.cold_light_color_temp_kelvin: Color temperature of the cold light source (in Kelvin)

rgbw.description: Configure the RGBW controller and the channel mapping for warm and cold light

data_description.rgbw_controller_entity_id: The RGBW controller entity (e.g. Shelly RGBW2)
data_description.warm_channel: RGBW channel connected to the warm (yellow-ish) light, e.g. 'white'
data_description.warm_light_color_temp_kelvin: Color temperature of the warm light source (in Kelvin)
data_description.cold_channel: RGBW channel connected to the cold (blue-ish) light, e.g. 'blue'
data_description.cold_light_color_temp_kelvin: Color temperature of the cold light source (in Kelvin)

dual_light.description: Update the warm and cold light configuration

data_description.warm_light_entity_id: Light acting as the warmer light source (yellow-ish color)
data_description.warm_light_color_temp_kelvin: Color temperature of the warm light source (in Kelvin)
data_description.cold_light_entity_id: Light acting as the colder light source (blue-ish color)
data_description.cold_light_color_temp_kelvin: Color temperature of the cold light source (in Kelvin)

rgbw.description: Update the RGBW controller and channel mapping

data_description.rgbw_controller_entity_id: The RGBW controller entity (e.g. Shelly RGBW2)
data_description.warm_channel: RGBW channel connected to the warm (yellow-ish) light, e.g. 'white'
data_description.warm_light_color_temp_kelvin: Color temperature of the warm light source (in Kelvin)
data_description.cold_channel: RGBW channel connected to the cold (blue-ish) light, e.g. 'blue'
data_description.cold_light_color_temp_kelvin: Color temperature of the cold light source (in Kelvin)

cct_calibration.description: Define up to 5 reference temperature points and the corresponding warm/cold channel mix for your specific LED chip. The values are brightness-independent ratios: both fields can be 0–100 and the dominant channel is always scaled to the target brightness. Use the defaults if you are unsure — they reproduce the built-in linear formula.

data_description.cct_cal_1_temp: Reference color temperature for calibration point 1 (in Kelvin)
data_description.cct_cal_1_warm: Warm channel weight at this temperature (0 = off, 100 = maximum warm)
data_description.cct_cal_1_cold: Cold channel weight at this temperature (0 = off, 100 = maximum cold)
data_description.cct_cal_2_temp: Reference color temperature for calibration point 2 (in Kelvin)
data_description.cct_cal_2_warm: Warm channel weight at this temperature
data_description.cct_cal_2_cold: Cold channel weight at this temperature
data_description.cct_cal_3_temp: Reference color temperature for calibration point 3 (in Kelvin) – typically the neutral white point
data_description.cct_cal_3_warm: Warm channel weight at this temperature
data_description.cct_cal_3_cold: Cold channel weight at this temperature
data_description.cct_cal_4_temp: Reference color temperature for calibration point 4 (in Kelvin)
data_description.cct_cal_4_warm: Warm channel weight at this temperature
data_description.cct_cal_4_cold: Cold channel weight at this temperature
data_description.cct_cal_5_temp: Reference color temperature for calibration point 5 (in Kelvin)
data_description.cct_cal_5_warm: Warm channel weight at this temperature
data_description.cct_cal_5_cold: Cold channel weight at this temperature
